title: Cassia angustifolia essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cassia angustifolia essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the seeds of the Cassia angustifolia plant, commonly known as sickle pod or Indian senna. This essential oil is valued in herbalism for its stimulating and digestive properties, often used to support metabolic function and relieve constipation. It is typically diluted and applied topically or inhaled for its warming effects, which can help alleviate respiratory congestion and improve circulation. In traditional medicine, it has been used to treat skin conditions and as a natural remedy for digestive discomfort. Its strong aroma also makes it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy for its uplifting and energizing qualities.
